title: [dualtor] multiple traffic tests report traffic disruption prior to/at beginning of the test
author: theasianpianist

linkedPullRequests.title: [dualtor]: Improve tests
linkedPullRequests.author: theasianpianist
linkedPullRequests.body:
- Create separate folder for dualtor IO testing
- Adjust dualtor test initialization timing to reduce flakiness
- Do not restart mux simulator before each test module

Signed-off-by: Lawrence Lee <lawlee@microsoft.com>
